import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
from monai.networks.nets import UNet
from nvflare.apis.fl_context import FLContext
from nvflare.apis.shareable import Shareable
from nvflare.apis.signal import Signal
from nvflare.apis.dxo import DXO, from_shareable, to_shareable

from supervised_monai_prostate_learner import SupervisedMonaiProstateLearner
from supervised_pt_ditto_helper import SupervisedPTDittoHelper

class SupervisedMonaiProstateDittoLearner(SupervisedMonaiProstateLearner):
    def __init__(
        self,
        train_conf: str,
        aggregation_epochs: int,
        ditto_model_epochs: int,
        train_task_name: str,
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.train_conf = train_conf
        self.aggregation_epochs = aggregation_epochs
        self.ditto_model_epochs = ditto_model_epochs
        self.train_task_name = train_task_name
        self.ditto_helper = SupervisedPTDittoHelper(
            aggregation_epochs=self.aggregation_epochs,
            ditto_model_epochs=self.ditto_model_epochs,
            train_task_name=self.train_task_name,
        )
        self.model = None
        self.optimizer = None

    def train_config(self, fl_ctx: FLContext):
        super().train_config(fl_ctx)
        self.model = UNet(
            dimensions=3,
            in_channels=1,
            out_channels=2,
            channels=(16, 32, 64, 128, 256),
            strides=(2, 2, 2, 2),
            num_res_units=2,
        ).to(self.ditto_helper.device)
        self.optimizer = optim.Adam(self.model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)
        self.ditto_helper.set_model_and_optimizer(self.model, self.optimizer)

    def train(self, shareable: Shareable, fl_ctx: FLContext, abort_signal: Signal) -> Shareable:
        if abort_signal.triggered:
            return Shareable()
        # Update local model weights with received weights
        dxo = from_shareable(shareable)
        if dxo.data_kind == "WEIGHTS":
            self.ditto_helper.load_weights(dxo.data)
        # Load Ditto personalized model
        self.ditto_helper.load_personalized_model()
        # Local training on reference model and personalized model
        self.ditto_helper.local_train(abort_signal)
        # Validate Ditto model each round
        metrics = self.ditto_helper.validate()
        # Compute delta model
        delta_weights = self.ditto_helper.compute_delta()
        # Return shareable object with updated local model
        result_dxo = DXO(data_kind="WEIGHTS", data=delta_weights)
        result_shareable = to_shareable(result_dxo)
        result_shareable.set_header("metrics", metrics)
        return result_shareable
